_comment: Single source of truth for the release family. Every release script (build_release.py,
make_model_cards.py, hf_upload.py, upload_datasets.py) iterates this list.
FINAL epoch ships (checkpoint_last, EMA weights; calibration.json is fitted on it).
Released family = HICO-DET 0.05 + source-aware negative masking recipe on the full pack.
The *-zeroshot entries are the same recipe with no HICO-DET in the mixture: the paper's
zero-shot rows. They are status=unreleased -- no weights are published for them, and every
release script skips them -- but they stay here because release_gate.py measures each
released model against its zero-shot sibling, and overall_score.py takes the head-to-head
HICO-DET cell from the zero-shot tower (the released one saw HICO-DET train).
run_dir names the training run under $RA_RUNS/train on the training machine;
hf_repo is where the weights are published, and only released entries have one.
